resources.string: Which one answered best? Pick it below: it adds to the wins in Statistics.

Send the same prompt to all of them at once and see which answers better and faster. Write your own or pick one of the recommended prompts. Each engine uses its own parameters: with “Use this configuration on all” (in Parameters) you equalize them for a fair comparison.
Summarize what quantum computing is in 3 bullet points.
Write a Kotlin function that reverses a linked list.
Translate into Spanish: \"On-device artificial intelligence changes the rules of the game.\"
If a train leaves at 14:00 at 80 km/h and another leaves at 14:30 at 100 km/h in the same direction, when does the second catch up?
Extract name, date and amount from: \"John Smith paid $4500 on 03/12/2026.\"
Write a 3-line micro-story about a robot that learns to dream.
Classify this message as spam or not spam: \"You won a prize, click here now!!!\"
Explain step by step how to change a car wheel.
